newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Varitronix down on flat interim growth.
newsitem.headline: Varitronix down on flat interim growth.

text.p: Shares of liquid crystal display maker Varitronix International Ltd fell after the company reported flat earnings growth, brokers said on Friday.
"Excluding the exceptional, the company achieved only flat growth in interim earnings and that triggered light selling," said an analyst at a local brokerage.
Varitronix shares fell HK$0.80, or 5.52 percent, to an intraday low of HK$13.70 in late trade.
Varitronix reported interim net profit of HK$111.84 million, including an exceptional gain of HK$5.83 million, compared with HK$106.45 million a year ago. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
